slides.sub: Here's what Denville's NJ Transit station gives you before you make the move.

slides.title: Morristown Line
slides.body: Denville is on NJ Transit's Morristown Line, with trains to New York Penn Station and Hoboken. Through Nov. 14, weekday Midtown Direct trains end at Hoboken.
slides.source: NJ Transit, Denville Station and Portal Cutover (Oct. 2026)

slides.title: Montclair-Boonton Line
slides.body: The Montclair-Boonton Line stops at the same station, with service to Hoboken.
slides.source: NJ Transit, Denville Station and Montclair-Boonton Line (Oct. 2026)

slides.title: Station parking
slides.body: NJ Transit owns 2 lots here. Lot 2 takes daily parkers at $4 a day or a $150 quarterly permit. Evenings and weekends are free.

slides.title: Your Denville commute
slides.tip: Touring homes here? Time the drive from the house to Estling Lake Road at rush hour before you decide.

caption:
Struggling to pick a Morris County train town? Listen. Denville has one station and 2 NJ Transit lines.

The Morristown Line stops in Denville with trains to New York Penn Station and Hoboken. Heads up: through Nov. 14, weekday Midtown Direct trains end at Hoboken during NJ Transit's Portal Bridge work. The Montclair-Boonton Line stops at the same station, with service to Hoboken. NJ Transit owns 2 lots on Estling Lake Road. Parking is $4 a day or $150 a quarter with a permit, and evenings and weekends are free.

Touring homes in Denville? Time the drive from the house to the station at rush hour before you decide.
